S50Z26.today_summary: 1,019.0 on the Dec future, +5.6 and a fourth straight advance that has recovered 27.7 of the 27.0 points lost on 11-07. Max pain sits 11 points above spot at 1030 while net dealer gamma is -3,138, so dealers stay short gamma around the anchor with no flip strike anywhere between 950 and 1150. The 1050 near call wall (1,891 OI) traded 400 lots but lost 113 contracts of OI with its IV down 1.11 points - a wall being closed, not defended. ATM IV at 12.33% is the lowest print in six sessions and 6.0 vol points under 10-day realized of 18.32%.
what_changed: Net dealer gamma shrank to -3,138 from -3,817 yesterday and -9,434 on 11-07, unwinding 67% of the short-gamma load built in the selloff.
Call OI fell 306 to 18,875 on 1,688 lots of call volume, with the 1040-1080 strip shedding 352 contracts on 919 lots - the live resistance above spot is being bought back.
ATM IV compressed 0.80 points to 12.33%, a six-session low, while 5-day realized printed 22.39%.
25D skew flipped to -0.49 (call-rich) from +0.17, and the chain grid extended down to 950 (669 put OI, 120 lots) as the downside tail stayed bid at +2.30 on 10D.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Over five sessions the Dec future ran 1018.2 to 991.3 to 1019.0, a full round trip, while max pain fell 1040 to 1030 and has now held there four sessions - the anchor came down to price as much as price came up to the anchor, so 1030 is convergence, not a magnet target. Net GEX went -5,788 to -9,434 on the 11-07 selloff and has decayed to -3,138, with put OI down 569 contracts and call OI up 2,203 over the same window, the biggest adds at 1100 (+537), 1090 (+257) and 1000 (+257). The near put wall migrated 1000 to 960 on the 11-07 panic and back to 1000 (2,130 OI, 252 lots today), while the 1050 near call wall never moved but is now being closed into rather than built. ATM IV compressed from 14.27% on 11-07 to 12.33% even as 5-day realized printed 22.39% and 10-day 18.32% - implied is pricing a 7.92-point daily range against a 9.92-point realized one. Five sessions ago this was a Protection-zone build; it is now an Unwind with dealers still short gamma but carrying only a third of the load, which is the cheapest convexity this series has offered in the window.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1030 / 1070
strategies.rationale: Buys the 1030 max-pain strike where per-strike net GEX turns positive and sells into the 1070 strike whose OI (992) sits above a 1040-1080 strip that shed 352 contracts on 919 lots today - resistance being closed rather than defended, financed at 12.33% IV against 18.32% 10-day realized.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of 10.15 points (12.60 - 2.45 at mid), 2,030 baht per contract at 200 baht/point. Max gain 29.85 points above 1070; breakeven 1040.15.
strategies.invalidation: A close back under 1000, the 2,130-OI near put wall - that puts price inside the -3,597 short-gamma pocket with the amplifier pointing down.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 970
strategies.rationale: Hedges the short-gamma pocket below 1030: dealers are short gamma at every strike from 950 up, so a rejection at the 1050 wall is amplified toward the 1000 near put wall (2,130 OI) and the 960 structural floor (3,053 OI), and the 10D put tail at +2.30 skew shows that tail is still the one being paid for.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of 6.40 points (11.05 - 4.65 at mid), 1,280 baht per contract. Max gain 23.60 points below 970; breakeven 993.60.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1050 on rising call volume with call OI still falling - the unwind continuing through the wall rather than reversing at it.

strategies.name: Defined-risk strangle: 1040/1080 call spread + 990/960 put spread
strategies.rationale: The purest read on the one number that matters: 12.33% implied against 18.32% 10-day and 22.39% 5-day realized, with dealers short gamma at all 21 strikes so any directional push gets hedged with the move rather than against it - and 47 DTE gives a 54-point 1-sigma window (7.92 x root-47) against breakevens only 33 points out.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = total debit of 11.80 points (7.20 call side + 4.60 put side), 2,360 baht per contract, realised if price finishes between 990 and 1040. Breakevens 1051.80 and 978.20.
strategies.invalidation: Net GEX turning positive at the anchor or ATM IV expanding back above 14.3% (the 11-07 print) - either removes the cheap-convexity premise.

S50Z26.prediction: 1030 is the pivot: above it per-strike net GEX turns positive and the 1040-1080 call strip is being closed rather than defended, which argues for continuation to the 1050 near call wall and, through it, the stale 1,100 wall that traded just 39 lots. Below 1019 the +/-20-point pocket is -3,597 GEX, so a rejection is amplified toward 1000 (2,130 put OI) and then the 960 floor (3,053 OI). A close under 1000 invalidates the neutral-bullish tilt; the structural read either way is that 12.33% implied is the mispriced leg, not the direction.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and no share-settlement pressure: max pain at 1030 and the 1050/960 walls are tendencies and anchors, structurally weaker than pins on physically-settled single stocks, and at 47 DTE pin mechanics barely apply at all. Defined risk is not low risk - each debit above can be lost in full. The 1,100 call wall (2,863 OI, 39 lots, flat IV) fails the Vol2Vol live-flow test and should not be weighted as active resistance.
